### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>Microsoft/go-winio (github.com/Microsoft/go-winio)</summary>

### [`v0.6.3`](https://redirect.github.com/microsoft/go-winio/releases/tag/v0.6.3)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/Microsoft/go-winio/compare/v0.6.2...v0.6.3)

#### What's Changed

- switch back from golang.org/x/sys/execabs to os/exec (go1.19) by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [microsoft#317](https://redirect.github.com/microsoft/go-winio/pull/317)
- Add Go wrappers for Get/SetVirtualDiskInformation win32 APIs. by [@​ambarve](https://redirect.github.com/ambarve) in [microsoft#334](https://redirect.github.com/microsoft/go-winio/pull/334)
- Add support for LX symlinks (0xA000001D) for WSL/MSYS2 compatibility by [@​vagokuln-msft](https://redirect.github.com/vagokuln-msft) in [microsoft#336](https://redirect.github.com/microsoft/go-winio/pull/336)
- backuptar: fix sparse stream handling in seekable exports by [@​rzlink](https://redirect.github.com/rzlink) in [microsoft#375](https://redirect.github.com/microsoft/go-winio/pull/375)
- Bump github.com/sirupsen/logrus from 1.9.3 to 1.10.2 by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [microsoft#374](https://redirect.github.com/microsoft/go-winio/pull/374)
- Pin GitHub Actions to full-length commit SHAs by [@​danfiedler-msft](https://redirect.github.com/danfiedler-msft) in [microsoft#373](https://redirect.github.com/microsoft/go-winio/pull/373)
- ci: add windows-2025, remove windows-2019 by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [microsoft#378](https://redirect.github.com/microsoft/go-winio/pull/378)
- Bump actions/checkout from 4.4.0 to 7.0.1 by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [microsoft#380](https://redirect.github.com/microsoft/go-winio/pull/380)
- Bump actions/setup-go from 5.6.0 to 7.0.0 by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [microsoft#381](https://redirect.github.com/microsoft/go-winio/pull/381)
- go.mod: raise minimum go version to go1.24 and use tools directive by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [microsoft#348](https://redirect.github.com/microsoft/go-winio/pull/348)
- Restrict CI workflow token permissions by [@​jterry75](https://redirect.github.com/jterry75) with [@​Copilot](https://redirect.github.com/Copilot) in [microsoft#382](https://redirect.github.com/microsoft/go-winio/pull/382)
- Use go tool to run stringer by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [microsoft#383](https://redirect.github.com/microsoft/go-winio/pull/383)
- ci: update actions and golangci-lint, and fix linting by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [microsoft#349](https://redirect.github.com/microsoft/go-winio/pull/349)
- fix linting issues by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [microsoft#325](https://redirect.github.com/microsoft/go-winio/pull/325)
- Bump golang.org/x/tools to v0.50.0 by [@​jterry75](https://redirect.github.com/jterry75) in [microsoft#385](https://redirect.github.com/microsoft/go-winio/pull/385)
- Resolves race in makeConnectedServerPipe / Close by [@​jterry75](https://redirect.github.com/jterry75) in [microsoft#388](https://redirect.github.com/microsoft/go-winio/pull/388)
- tools/mkwinsyscall: remove errnoERROR_IO_PENDING const by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [microsoft#260](https://redirect.github.com/microsoft/go-winio/pull/260)
- linting: enable dupword, intrange, mirror, gocritic by [@​alexandear](https://redirect.github.com/alexandear) in [microsoft#387](https://redirect.github.com/microsoft/go-winio/pull/387)
- improve interoperability with stdlib sentinel errors and deprecate aliases by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [microsoft#392](https://redirect.github.com/microsoft/go-winio/pull/392)
